shortDescription: Module for setup of SystemConfiguration Avi RESTful Object

options.name: admin_auth_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_email_login_password
options.description: Password for avi_email_login user. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: common_criteria_mode
options.description: Common criteria modes current state. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_analytics_policy
options.description: Controller metrics event dynamic thresholds can be set here. Controller_cpu_high and controller_mem_high evets can take configured dynamic thresholds. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: default_license_tier
options.description: Specifies the default license tier which would be used by new clouds. Enum options - ENTERPRISE_16, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_18, BASIC, ESSENTIALS, ENTERPRISE_WITH_CLOUD_SERVICES. Field introduced in 17.2.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Special default for essentials edition is essentials, basic edition is basic, enterprise edition is enterprise_with_cloud_services. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted

options.name: dns_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dns_virtualservice_refs
options.description: Dns virtualservices hosting fqdn records for applications across avi vantage. If no virtualservices are provided, avi vantage will provide dns services for configured applications. Switching back to avi vantage from dns virtualservices is not allowed. It is a reference to an object of type virtualservice. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: docker_mode
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: email_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable_cors
options.description: Enable cors header. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_host_header_check
options.description: Validates the host header against a list of trusted domains. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_license_quota
options.description: Enable license quota for the system. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: fips_mode
options.description: Fips mode current state. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: global_tenant_config
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: host_key_algorithm_exclude
options.description: Users can specify comma separated list of deprecated host key algorithm.if nothing is specified, all known algorithms provided by openssh will be supported.this change could only apply on the controller node. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: kex_algorithm_exclude
options.description: Users can specify comma separated list of deprecated key exchange algorithm.if nothing is specified, all known algorithms provided by openssh will be supported.this change could only apply on the controller node. Field introduced in 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: legacy_ssl_support
options.description: Allow outgoing connections from controller to servers using tls 1.0/1.1. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: license_quota
options.description: License quota for the system. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: linux_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: mgmt_ip_access_control
options.description: Configure ip access control for controller to restrict open access. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ntp_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: password_policy_managed_at_ops
options.description: Indicates whether password policy fields are managed by vcf-ops. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: portal_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: proxy_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: rekey_time_limit
options.description: Users can specify and update the time limit of rekeylimit in sshd_config.if nothing is specified, the default setting will be none. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as none.

options.name: rekey_volume_limit
options.description: Users can specify and update the size/volume limit of rekeylimit in sshd_config.if nothing is specified, the default setting will be default. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as default.

options.name: sddcmanager_fqdn
options.description: Fqdn of sddc manager in vcf responsible for management of this alb controller cluster. Field introduced in 22.1.6,31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: secure_channel_configuration
options.description: Configure secure channel properties. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: service_auth_configurations
options.description: Service auth configurations. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: snmp_configuration
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ssh_ciphers
options.description: Allowed ciphers list for ssh to the management interface on the controller and service engines. If this is not specified, all the default ciphers are allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ssh_hmacs
options.description: Allowed hmac list for ssh to the management interface on the controller and service engines. If this is not specified, all the default hmacs are allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: sync_kex_host_to_se
options.description: Ability to sync the kexalgorithms & hostkeyalgorithms to ses. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: sync_syslog_to_se
options.description: Ability to sync the syslog server config to ses. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: syslog_servers
options.description: The destination syslog server ip(v4/v6) address or fqdn. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: telemetry_configuration
options.description: Telemetry configuration. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: trusted_host_profiles_refs
options.description: Trusted host profiles for host header validation. Only works when host_header_check is set to true. It is a reference to an object of type trustedhostprofile. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Maximum of 20 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: truststore_pkiprofile_ref
options.description: Reference to pkiprofile used for validating the ca certificates for external comminications from avi load balancer controller  this acts as trust store for avi load balancer controller. It is a reference to an object of type pkiprofile. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: welcome_workflow_complete
options.description: This flag is set once the initial controller setup workflow is complete. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.
